{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, check which rows have commas
has_comma = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of rows with comma in revenue: {has_comma.sum()}")

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Filter out QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now check the loyal customer segment
loyal_mask = df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
print(f"Number of loyal customers in clean data: {loyal_mask.sum()}")

# Extract the converted column for loyal customers
converted_loyal = df_clean[loyal_mask]['converted']

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = converted_loyal.mean()
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")

# Print the number of loyal customers and converted ones
print(f"Total loyal: {len(converted_loyal)}, Converted: {converted_loyal.sum()}")"}
